title: Static Generation with getStaticProps
description: Fetch data at build time to create blazing‑fast, fully‑rendered HTML pages.

slides.title: The Magic Function: getStaticProps 🪄
Simple Blog Page (pages/posts.js)
slides.content: Fetch a list of posts at build time and render them. The data is embedded in the HTML.

quizData.question: Where does `getStaticProps` run?

options.text: Only at build time on the server
Every time the page loads in the browser

quizData.explanation: `getStaticProps` runs at build time in the Node.js environment. It's never sent to the client.

slides.title: The Return Object 🔙
404 via notFound (pages/product.js)
slides.content: If a product doesn't exist, return `notFound: true` to show the 404 page.

quizData.question: What happens if you return `{ notFound: true }` from `getStaticProps`?

options.text: The user is redirected to the home page

quizData.explanation: `notFound: true` triggers the built‑in or custom 404 page with a 404 status code.
